source: Hash-verified Open Food Facts package-photo manifest; photographs and OCR text are not written to this receipt.

methods.tesseractJs: Tesseract.js 7 English best_int, PSM.SINGLE_BLOCK, source image bytes; parsed through the production label parser.
methods.tesseractJsBrowserPrepared: Tesseract.js 7 English best_int, PSM.SINGLE_BLOCK, EXIF-rotated and resized to 3,000 px maximum edge, JPEG quality 98; matches the Node proxy used for browser-path preparation evaluation.
methods.rapidOcr: RapidOCR 3.10.0, PP-OCRv6 small ONNX Runtime CPU detector/recognizer; detected boxes are grouped by vertical position and x-ordered into rows before parsing through the production label parser.
methods.rapidOcrGuidedCrops: The same RapidOCR path on two preselected nutrition-panel crops also used in the Tesseract guided-crop probe: Saffola 3/0/93/99 percent and Bagrry’s 2/2/74/96 percent. EXIF-rotated, resized to 3,000 px maximum edge and JPEG 98.

limitations: Five selected public package photographs and human annotations plus two guided crops; not a held-out or population accuracy estimate.
Only annotated nutrient fields at the declared basis are scored. Text-character accuracy and table-reading order are not ground-truthed.
RapidOCR text boxes are grouped with a simple vertical-center tolerance; dense or multicolumn table structure and per-value column alignment are not ground-truthed.
Both OCR readings are observations. A correct match does not verify package identity, label truth, formulation or clinical relevance.
RapidOCR ran as a local Python CPU diagnostic, not inside Chrome and not as part of the shipped product.
